activity.notes: Records Přemysl Ottokar II's Bohemian kingship only. His additional Austrian, Styrian, Carinthian and Carniolan titles are not collapsed into this single Activity and may be represented separately if later required.

sources.citation_text: The Croatian Encyclopedia identifies Otakar II as Czech/Bohemian king from 1253 and records his death in 1278.

sources.title: Ottocar II — The Columbia Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: The Columbia Encyclopedia identifies Přemysl Ottocar II as king of Bohemia from 1253 to 1278 and son and successor of Wenceslaus I.
